notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. The token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat
